the truck scheduling problems for solid waste collection can be modeled as special cases of the single-dept vehicle scheduling problems and that the truck scheduling considering balanced unloading of collection trips can be solved by a heuristic approach.

the proposed heuristic approach can be successfully applied in practice to solve the problem of designing daily truck schedules for solid waste collection, while achieving both cost reduction and balanced unloading at recycling facilities.

a heuristic algorithm is able to find good truck schedules for a solid waste collection problem, which simultaneously reduce the total costs and balances unloading assignments to the recycling facilities.
